summary: Tested 4 assertions: all 4 passed. React app loads correctly with Vite, React Router navigation works between all 3 routes (/, /start, /promotion) with correct URL updates and no full page reloads. Tailwind CSS v4 processes styles correctly with CSS custom properties and utility classes applied. All required shadcn/ui components (Button, Card, Input, Label, Select, Dialog, Tabs, Toast) render correctly with proper styling and interactivity. No console errors observed.
